screen.// note: If auto_detect is true, width/height are ignored.

capture.// fov: Grab zone size in pixels (centered on screen). Larger = wider scan, slower.

aimbot.// speed: Mouse movement multiplier. Lower = smoother, higher = snappier. Range: 0.05 - 1.0
aimbot.// headshot_offset: Pixels from top of detected target to aim at. Higher = lower on body.
aimbot.// min_pixels: Minimum matching pixels to count as a valid target.

triggerbot.// threshold: How close the crosshair must be to the target center to fire (pixels).

color.// color: HSV range for target detection. Purple/Magenta outlines by default.

// toggle_key: Key to toggle the aimbot ON/OFF. Use keyboard library key names.
// ui_refresh_rate: Console status line refresh rate in Hz.
